name: Heart Stance
description: Take the school's stance with the user's heart steady and a second heart held in mind.

name: Second Beat
description: Count the second heart's beat beside the first and find where the two disagree.

name: Twin Breath
description: Breathe once for each heart until both fall into the same slow time.

name: Matched Dread
description: Match a foe's dread to a second foe's so that each fears the other.

name: Pressure Pair
description: Press two weights of felt unease on a single foe from opposite sides.

name: Courage Pair
description: Pass a pair of bolstering pulses to allies so that each hears the other's courage.

name: Twin Rout
description: Break a foe's nerve with two waves of dread from either hand in the same moment.

name: Heart Cleanse
description: Pass the lingering fear of an ally through the second heart and let it burn off.

name: Doubled Command
description: Set two hearts to one beat so that foes sag and allies stand taller.

name: Heart Verdict
description: The school's closing move that presses two matched weights of feeling on a foe and tips their will by the user's reserve.

name: Calm Entrance
description: Enter the court of feeling and set a firm calm between the user and the crowd.

name: Hear Plea
description: Hear the plea beneath a crowd's shouting and learn what each wants.

name: Order Held
description: Keep the order of the court and let disorder of feeling pass round it.

name: Case Weigh
description: Weigh the feeling of a foe and tell if it is guilt or anger or fear.

name: Mercy Grant
description: Grant mercy to a spirit crushed by shame and lift the weight of it.

name: Silence Ordered
description: Order a hostile spirit to silence and let the order press down on its feeling.

name: Case Stated
description: State a foe's hidden fault aloud in feeling and watch their purpose crumble.

name: Sentence Weight
description: Pass sentence on a foe's will and let the weight of it settle on every move.

name: Closing Calm
description: Spread the calm of a closed court over allies and mend their rattled spirits.

name: Final Appeal
description: Hear a whole host and still every feeling that is raised against the user.

name: Heart Decree
description: The school's closing move that decrees an end to hostile feeling and lifts allies by the user's reserve.

name: Crown Foot
description: Set the foot of the spirit crown on the core and ward the feeling of the self.

name: Hearing Track
description: Run the first track of the crown outward to hear the feeling of those near.

name: Speaking Track
description: Run the second track outward to speak a steady feeling into those near.

name: Track Balance
description: Balance the two tracks until the crown rests easy on the head.

name: Meeting Crest
description: Bring the two tracks to meet at the crest so that hostile feeling breaks on both.

name: Crown Reach
description: Reach out along both tracks and learn the state of every near spirit.

name: Host Calm
description: Pour calm along both tracks into a frightened host and quiet their fear.

name: Crown Drain
description: Drain dread from a host through the crown and let it run to nothing.

name: One Heart
description: Make a whole host beat as one heart under the steady rhythm of the crown.

name: Rival Quell
description: Quell the feeling of a rival host with the converging weight of both tracks.

name: Hearts Crowned
description: Hold the full crown over a host so that allies rise as one and foes sink.

name: Spirit Crown Fall
description: The school's closing move that brings the crown down on the field and moves every heart in it by the user's reserve.

name: Listening Oath
description: Swear to listen first and keep the spirit open to the wind.

name: Wind Whisper
description: Catch the whisper of a distant spirit as it comes on the wind.

name: Meant Only
description: Answer only the feeling that is meant and let idle spite blow by.

name: Soft Gale
description: Send a soft gale of calm through a shaken ally.

name: Spite Scatter
description: Scatter a hostile feeling on the wind before it reaches the user.

name: Oath Carry
description: Carry the oath to an ally so that they too listen before they answer.

name: Hearing Hold
description: Hold the listening oath through a roar of crowd spite without answering.

name: Breeze Unburden
description: Hear the bitterness out of an ally and let the wind carry it away.

name: Heard Sovereign
description: Hear every spirit near and still the ill-meant ones.

name: Hearing Oath
description: The school's closing move that rests on the oath to listen and stills hostile feeling by the user's reserve.

name: High Feel
description: Stand in the spirit on a high plain and feel the distant weather of hearts.

name: Rise Reading
description: Watch a feeling begin to rise in a distant foe and judge where it will break.

name: Wide Skirt
description: Skirt wide of a rising feeling to leave it no purchase on the user.

name: Far Quiet
description: Send the quiet of the plain to an ally who stands far off.

name: Early Mark
description: Mark a threatening heart on the horizon before it comes near.

name: Broad Pressure
description: Spread broad pressure over the approaching hearts of a host and slow them.

name: Level Rally
description: Rally allies across the plain with a single clear feeling of readiness.

name: Skyline Hold
description: Hold the whole horizon of feeling and let no hostile heart rise inside it.

name: Heart Reckoning
description: Reckon each heart of the foe and break the ones that are weakest.

name: Sovereign Reading
description: Make the whole field a plain where every heart is read and held steady.

name: Unclouded Heart
description: The school's closing move that lays a clear plain over a host and holds every heart by the user's reserve.

name: Wind Bearing
description: Take the school's bearing in the spirit and keep it as the wind rises.

name: Sway Test
description: Test how far a swaying feeling has moved the user from the bearing.

name: Blown Feeling
description: Let a blown feeling pass overhead and not take root in the spirit.

name: Return Calm
description: Bring a gust-struck ally back to the calm of the bearing.

name: Borrowed Cancel
description: Cancel a borrowed feeling placed in an ally by a hostile spirit.

name: Heading Lend
description: Lend an ally the bearing so that their spirit stops swaying.

name: Storm Keeping
description: Keep the bearing through a storm of hostile feeling from a whole host.

name: Wind Reversal
description: Turn the storm of feeling about and send it back through the bearing.

name: Keel Sovereign
description: Hold the deepest bearing and cancel every sway while allies stand fast.

name: Unswayed Heart
description: The school's closing move that holds the bearing against every feeling and stills a host by the user's reserve.
